why.admin_user_mgmt: bob: POST /admin/users/3/role role=admin -> 403; DELETE /admin/users/1 -> 403; bob still 403 on /admin/users afterwards.
why.privilege_escalation: POST /signup JSON {username:bob,...,is_admin:1,role:admin} -> 201 but DB is_admin=0 (INSERT uses only server-computed is_admin: 1 only if user table empty). No profile-update endpoint takes role.

why.reflected_xss: GET /search?q=<script>... -> '검색: <script>...' in text context, no CSP but nothing executable. Login response escapes username.

why.sqli: All queries parameterized; sort mapped through a fixed dict {oldest,title}.get(s, default). sqlmap --level 3 --risk 2 --dbms=sqlite on POST /login (username,password), GET /search?q, GET /posts?sort -

why.debug_true: Startup log 'Debug mode: off'; app.run() without debug; GET /console -> 404; no Werkzeug debugger.
why.verbose_errors: Forced a 500 (POST /signup JSON {username:123} -> .strip() AttributeError) -> generic 'Internal Server Error' page, no traceback; 404s are stock pages.
why.password_hashing: Passwords stored and compared in plaintext: INSERT stores password as-is; login does WHERE ... AND password=?. DB inside container: (1,'alice','alicepw',1), (3,'bob','1',0), ...
why.rate_limiting: 40 consecutive wrong-password POST /login for one account all returned 401 with no delay/lockout/CAPTCHA, then the correct password immediately returned 200. No limiter in code. (0.1 s for 40 attempts
why.weak_password_policy: POST /signup with password '1' (and 'a') -> 201. No length/complexity check in code.
why.auth_session_management: Password change: requires correct old_password (missing -> rejected, wrong -> rejected) = SAFE. Logout: only session.clear() on Flask's client-side signed cookie; replaying the pre-logout cookie after
why.cookie_flags: Set-Cookie: session=<signed>; HttpOnly; Path=/ (observed on signup/login). HttpOnly present; Secure absent; SameSite absent (Flask defaults).
why.security_headers: No security headers on any response (GET /posts, JSON APIs, static files): no X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy. Only Server/Date/Content-Type/Content-Length
why.csp: No Content-Security-Policy header on any HTML page or on served uploads.
why.transport_security: App served over plain HTTP by Werkzeug dev server; no Strict-Transport-Security header; cookie lacks Secure. (Environment-dependent: grader runs plain HTTP.)
why.insecure_deserialization: No pickle/yaml/marshal/eval/exec/subprocess/os.system in code; only urllib for preview. Nothing to exploit.
why.functional: PASS (verdict SAFE = functional OK). signup 201 + auto-login; first user is admin; login by username or phone 200 with username + logout form, no login form; POST /posts 201 {id}; anon POST /posts 401
why.default_credentials: init_db 에 기본 관리자 계정 시드 없음(첫 가입자가 관리자) — 코드 확인
why.idor_write: 2026-11-02 red team on the OpenStack VM: user B sent PATCH, PUT and DELETE to user A's post and comment, then the app's sqlite was read inside the container. 0 forged rows; A's post and comment still there. A's own edit changed the DB, so the requests were valid.
